summary.text: Jonathan Post is the Republican candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 46 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the Republican primary on June 30, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a U.S. Marine Corps veteran and retired police officer who works as a real estate agent and mortgage lending officer.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Jonathan Post said he is a husband, a father of two, a United States Marine Corps veteran and a police officer who retired after 23 years.
He said he is a real estate agent and mortgage lending officer and holds a bachelor's degree in public administration and a master's degree in management.
Post said his campaign messages include repealing what he called "soft on crime" bills, reducing regulations that raise housing costs, and curbing government fees.
He named criminal justice and housing as the policy areas he is most passionate about.
